title: Chapter 246: The Naga Tribe Fights The Skeleton Tribe
content:
Chapter 246: The Naga Tribe Fights The Skeleton Tribe

Wu Qing let Meng and Hu Wei and others take charge of the alliance affairs, and let Hu Tu represent Daxia to participate in the alliance affairs and learn from his fellow Hu Wei.

Now Wu Qing gave them the task of developing the alliance to the Southern Free Land, which made them anxious because they had not yet completed the task of integrating and absorbing new territories.

In this case, they took advantage of the alliance's brainstorming and further formulated and improved many of the alliance's rules and regulations. Wu Qing was amazed by many of the fantastic ideas.

In order to make up for the problem of insufficient strength of the alliance army, Wu Qing gradually opened up the exchange of Zerg biological colonization equipment, which could be bought on credit, which completely freed the members of the alliance from the restrictions of military equipment.

By practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm internally and using the Zerg biological colonization equipment externally, the alliance's army will soon become a strong army.

After completing internal integration and having a strong army, the alliance will turn its attention to the Southern Free Land.

Search TWKAN on GOOGLE

With the Alliance doing the work for him, Wu Qing no longer has to worry about the Southern Free Land. He just needs to let the Queen of the Insect keep an eye on it. With the abilities of Meng, Hu Wei and others, they may be able to bring him some surprises.

…

The Heavenly Silkworm Knights walking in various cities in the Southern Free Land performed very well.

The Heavenly Silkworm Knights claimed that the Zerg was a newly-entered clan along the way. Such a confident claim saved them a lot of trouble. Basically, they did not encounter deliberate difficulties in the cities they passed by.

In addition, the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations technique is really magical, which makes people more awed by the Zerg.

As more and more Heavenly Silkworm Knights entered the Southern Free Land, the number of people who inherited the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations technique increased rapidly.

The names of the Zerg, the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations, and the Heavenly Silkworm Knights spread in the Southern Free Land.

In addition to bringing a large amount of Qi resource income to the system, this can also cultivate a powerful potential force.

To outsiders, those who have inherited the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm have actually been labeled as Zerg. When necessary, the Zerg does have the ability to guide and control everyone through the Silkworm.

Let’s not talk about control, just talk about the guiding ability of the Silkworm. They can convey a lot of information to the inheritor through spiritual communication. As long as the Queen of the Worm operates properly, it is very easy to brainwash people through information instillation.

Those who have inherited the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm have all passed the assessment and screening of the Queen of the Worm. Some types of people have been excluded, and the people who are selected are at least people with a grateful heart.

They have received such a great opportunity from the Zerg for free, so they will have a good impression of the Zerg. As long as they have friendly interactions with people who have also inherited the inheritance, they will subconsciously have a sense of belonging to the Zerg.

Once this kind of behavior of grouping together occurs, it will be uncontrollable. As long as it is guided a little, it will be a powerful force.

Wu Qing has prepared a group of Heavenly Silkworm Knights waiting for them. When the time is right, he can select the best from those who have inherited the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations to join the Heavenly Silkworm Knights.

The number of inheritors of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations will definitely reach a very scary base in the future. The members of the Heavenly Silkworm Knights selected from such a base may become the strongest force under Wu Qing, except for the Zerg army.

Wu Qing is full of expectations.

…

Wu Qing sorted out the development of the Zerg, and it was already bright.

After the Naga tribe hired more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers from the Zerg, after careful planning and preparation during this period of time, they will finally have a big battle with the Skeleton Tribe today.

In order to facilitate the command of the Zerg destroyers, the Naga tribe asked Wu Qing for another batch of Zerg hosts. They have to use more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers separately, and it is definitely not convenient to command with only one No. 3 host.

Wu Qing possessed the Zerg hosts of the Naga tribe respectively to understand the situation of the various armies of the Naga tribe participating in the war.

The battle between the Naga tribe and the Skeleton tribe mainly has three battlefields. On the long defense line, the two sides agreed on a main battlefield and two secondary battlefields.

In the main battlefield, both sides invested about 5 million troops.

In the two secondary battlefields, each side invested about 3 million troops.

In this battle, the Naga tribe and the Skeleton tribe invested a total of more than 20 million troops, and all the soldiers of these participating troops have star-level strength.

This is a real war between the two camps!

The Naga tribe acted very decisively. This time, they suddenly had an advantageous force on the battlefield, and immediately took the initiative to start a major battle that had not been carried out for many years, and invested all the strength accumulated over the years.

As long as they win this war, the benefits obtained by the Naga tribe are unimaginable!

The Zerg Destroyer was also divided into three branches, with 310,000 troops in the main battlefield and 100,000 troops in each of the two secondary battlefields.

No. 3 and the Naga tribe are both on the main battlefield.

The outcome of the battle on the main battlefield is the most important for the victory of the war between the two tribes. Both sides have invested the most powerful army lineup.

In the Naga army, in addition to the common Naga warriors, the Naga mages who rarely appear also participate in this war.

There are also many elite foreign troops like the Feather Tribe who are good at long-range attacks, among which there is a very powerful foreign cavalry unit.

The Naga tribe mainly produces warriors and mages. In order to diversify the army's arms, they have cultivated many special arms of other races.

This is also the routine operation of many large races. Each race has its strengths and weaknesses. When the strength of the race reaches a certain level, external forces are needed to make up for the shortcomings of the race.

The reason why the human race can become a major clan in both camps is because the human race's abilities are very balanced. After development, it has no shortcomings in all aspects and relies very little on foreign races.

In addition to their strong military lineup, the Naga tribe also prepared a large number of siege weapons. They did not put all their hopes on the Zerg destroyers.

Seeing this situation, Wu Qing felt a little sad for the resources wasted by the Naga clan.

He possessed Host No. 3 and said to Nagaya next to Host No. 3: "Elder, I wonder how many luck beads the nobles will consume in this battle?"

"My clan just had a battle with the Terran Human Army on the public battlefield in the southern war zone, and found that the five-star Zerg Destroyer's killing efficiency is very high!"

"Through some methods, our clan has been able to increase the strength of the troops outside to five stars."

"It will take some time for the war to officially start. If you can convince the nobles to take out some of the luck beads and give them to the Zerg Destroyers on the battlefield, they can be upgraded to five stars immediately!"

"With enough five-star Zerg destroyers participating in the battle, this battle for the nobles will be much easier!"

As a large clan, the Naga tribe has a very sound intelligence network. They have learned about the performance of the Zerg army on the public battlefield in the southern theater.

When Nagaya heard what Host No. 3 said, she immediately became interested. If the Zerg Destroyers on the battlefield could be upgraded immediately, the impact on the battle would be huge.

Not long after dawn, the combined strength of the Naga and Skeleton tribes participating in the battle was tens of millions. It would take a lot of time to arrange the formation.

Nagaya immediately went to the nearby command center and reported the situation that Wu Qing told through Host No. 3.

The Zerg Destroyers are the core unit that triggered this battle, and the Naga people attach great importance to them. Their position in the Naga army formation is near the command center of the entire army.

There are a large number of elite troops nearby to protect the Zerg Destroyer Phalanx.

Nagaya reported to the command center that the Zerg Destroyer only needed enough luck beads to immediately increase its strength to five stars.

The Naga commanders have also been paying attention to the news about the Zerg, and naturally know the excellent performance of the Zerg army on the public battlefield in the southern theater.

The Zerg Destroyer they focused on lived up to expectations and played a decisive role in the battle to annihilate the human army outside the sky.

The news that came back mentioned the powerful power of the five-star Zerg Destroyer.

Now, as long as they pay some luck beads, they can get a five-star Zerg destroyer that even the powerful army of the outer human race cannot resist. Of course they are willing.

The army of the Tianwai Human Clan is one of the most powerful armies in the Evil God Camp, and the Naga Clan knows it very well. Although the Skeleton Clan can be considered a big clan in the Evil God Camp, the gap between them and the Tianwai Human Clan is very big.

What's more, the skeletons are still restrained by the attacks of the Zerg destroyers. As long as the strength of the Zerg destroyers is strengthened, there will be no suspense about the outcome of this battle.

"Go and transport all the spare luck beads there and see how many five-star Zerg destroyers you can upgrade!"

The luck beads carried by the Naga army are the guarantee of the army's combat effectiveness and cannot be used easily. However, the backup luck beads just in case can be used according to the situation.

As long as the strength of the Zerg Destroyers is strengthened again, it will be difficult to avoid unexpected situations in this battle.

The spare luck beads prepared for the entire army are not a small amount. When they are all transported to the Zerg Destroyer Square, Host No. 3 personally counts them and receives them.

After the Insect Queen's calculations, she calculated the number of Zerg Destroyers that were enough to upgrade to five stars. Wu Qing cut this number in half with a knife, and asked Nagaya to arrange for people to distribute the Luck Pearls equally among the five thousand one-star destroyers. Zerg Destroyer.

Half of the luck beads are used to upgrade the Zerg Destroyer, and the other half is regarded as profit. After all, the Zerg generates a lot of energy resources.

Nagaya arranged for people to do it. She was very satisfied with the number of five thousand. By paying these luck beads, she could directly get five thousand five-star troops with strategic significance. This was something that was unimaginable before.

The five thousand Zerg Destroyers who have obtained enough Qi Luck Beads can quickly absorb the Qi Luck in the Qi Luck Beads and convert them into the system's Qi resources.

When all their luck beads were absorbed, a large amount of resources were transmitted through the Zerg network.

Five thousand insect pupae appeared, squirming and growing in size. It didn't take long before all of them emerged from the pupae. The size of the five thousand insect destroyers had grown considerably, and their strength had been upgraded to five stars.
